title: Foundation
summary: Get the tools and repo ready, then test the riskiest assumptions with small throwaway experiments.

tasks.title: Confirm the toolchain
tasks.what: Checks that every build tool is installed and writes down its exact version.
tasks.why: Results can only be repeated when we know which tools made them.
tasks.how: Run each tool's version command and save the output as evidence.
tasks.chain: Tools installed → record exact versions → every later result names the tools it was built with.
tasks.check: Each tool prints a version; versions saved as evidence.

test_gate.explanation: Tools work → gate script passes → you review → only then does the next phase start.

rows.proves: All required tools installed, versions recorded
